keyFindings.description: settle keeps only the latest unacked save. A save that landed but returned an error (e.g. the 10 s saveTimeout during COMMIT), followed by a second save that fails before the compare-and-set answers, overwrites f.unacked with the longer, unlanded attempt; the next save gets MovedError with Held equal to the first landed length, which matches nothing, so save() sets f.stopped and nothing more of that file is saved for the generation, the final save included. Effect: the replacement pod resumes a truncated transcript and reminder record, or, on a fresh transcript's first save, the .legion-saved marker is never written and claude-envoy's claim boot waits forever (legion-claim.ts). No test covers the unacked path. Fix: keep every unacked length since the last committed save (or, on MovedError, read the row and adopt it when it is a prefix of the local file), and add a test with two failures in a row after a save that landed.
